# elemento Provider

Manages [Elemento Modular Cloud](https://elemento.cloud) resources on any cloud connected through [Atomosphere](https://elemento.cloud/atomosphere.html). The same resource types work on every cloud; `target` selects which one. To use several clouds in one configuration, declare one provider block per cloud with an `alias`.

```terraform
provider "elemento" {
  target   = "azure.dev.meson.elemento.cloud"
  username = var.elemento_username
  password = var.elemento_password
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Elemento account password. Falls back to `ELEMENTO_PASSWORD`.
- `portal` (String) Hostname of the Elemento Portal, used for authentication and billing. Defaults to `portal.elemento.cloud`. Falls back to `ELEMENTO_PORTAL`.
- `target` (String) Hostname of the Atomosphere (Meson) endpoint of the cloud to manage. Falls back to `ELEMENTO_TARGET`.
- `username` (String) Elemento account username. Falls back to `ELEMENTO_USERNAME`.
